## Run DE analysis

**Modified code from Catalyst to run using pseudobulk and metadata csv files***

Differential gene expression analysis of count data was performed using the Bioconductor R package, DESeq2, which fits the count data to a negative binomial model. In cases where there are multiple groups and conditions across groups, it is recommended to use dummy variables in the model instead of interaction terms: <https://bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/DESeq2/inst/doc/DESeq2.html#interactions>. **In this case, this means modeling a combined variable called `age_layer` instead of modeling both `age_group` and `cortical_layer` separately. **

Before fitting the model, we often look at a metric called dispersion, which is a measure for variance which also takes into consideration mean expression. A dispersion value is estimated for each individual gene, then 'shrunken' to a more accurate value based on expected variation for a typical gene exhibiting that level of expression. Finally, the shrunken dispersion value is used in the final GLM fit.

We use the below dispersion plot, which should show an inverse relationship between dispersion and mean expression, to get an idea of whether our data is a good fit for the model. **We see the expected inverse relationship, so our data is a good fit for the model.**


# Load required libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)


# Read the pseudobulk counts CSV
counts <- read.csv("pseudobulk_counts_general_code_age_layer.csv", check.names = FALSE)


# Load the file without assigning row names yet
cluster_counts_raw <- read.csv("pseudobulk_counts_general_code_age_layer.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# Check for duplicates in the first column (likely gene names)
sum(duplicated(cluster_counts_raw[, 1]))  # number of duplicate gene names

# Make unique gene names
cluster_counts_raw[, 1] <- make.unique(as.character(cluster_counts_raw[, 1]))

# Assign unique gene names as row names
rownames(cluster_counts_raw) <- cluster_counts_raw[, 1]

# Remove the first column since it's now the row names
cluster_counts <- cluster_counts_raw[, -1]

# Sanity check
dim(cluster_counts)
head(cluster_counts[, 1:5])

# Read the metadata CSV
metadata <- read.csv("pseudobulk_metadata_general_code_age_layer.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Check the column names and structure
str(metadata)

# Extract the age_layer column (column D)
age_layer <- metadata[[4]]  # or metadata$age_layer

# Preview it
age_layer <- metadata[[4]]; head(age_layer)


formula <- as.formula(paste0("~ ", " + ", 'age_layer'))

# Create sample metadata from vector
metadata <- data.frame(age_layer = age_layer)

# Set row names to match sample names in count matrix
rownames(metadata) <- colnames(cluster_counts)

# Check
head(metadata)

dds_to_use <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = cluster_counts,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ age_layer
)



# Rebuild DESeqDataSet
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = cluster_counts,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ age_layer  
)


# Run DESeq on your dds object
de <- DESeq(dds)

class(de)
# Should return "DESeqDataSet"

L1 old vs young

contrast <- c("age_layer", "old_L1", "young_L1")

# Raw log2 fold change results (no shrinkage)
resLFC <- results(de, contrast = contrast)

 
  # resLFCS <- lfcShrink(de, coef=coef, type="apeglm")
  resLFCS <- lfcShrink(de, contrast=contrast, type="ashr")
  
  # Inspect top genes
head(resLFCS[order(resLFCS$padj), ])

 
  res_df <- as.data.frame(resLFCS)
res_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_df)
# Reorder so gene_id is the first column (optional)
res_df <- res_df[, c("gene_id", setdiff(names(res_df), "gene_id"))]

  
  # Write to file
write.csv(res_df, file = "DESeq2_shrink_old_L1_vs_young_L1.csv", row.names = FALSE)



L2 old vs young

contrast <- c("age_layer", "old_L2", "young_L2")

# Raw log2 fold change results (no shrinkage)
resLFC <- results(de, contrast = contrast)

 
  # resLFCS <- lfcShrink(de, coef=coef, type="apeglm")
  resLFCS <- lfcShrink(de, contrast=contrast, type="ashr")
  
  # Inspect top genes
head(resLFCS[order(resLFCS$padj), ])

 
  res_df <- as.data.frame(resLFCS)
res_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_df)
# Reorder so gene_id is the first column (optional)
res_df <- res_df[, c("gene_id", setdiff(names(res_df), "gene_id"))]

  
  # Write to file
write.csv(res_df, file = "DESeq2_shrink_old_L2_vs_young_L2.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## Run DE analysis with sex as covariate***

# Load required libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)


# Read the pseudobulk counts CSV
counts <- read.csv("pseudobulk_counts_general_code_age_layer.csv", check.names = FALSE)


# Load the file without assigning row names yet
cluster_counts_raw <- read.csv("pseudobulk_counts_general_code_age_layer.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# Check for duplicates in the first column (likely gene names)
sum(duplicated(cluster_counts_raw[, 1]))  # number of duplicate gene names

# Make unique gene names
cluster_counts_raw[, 1] <- make.unique(as.character(cluster_counts_raw[, 1]))

# Assign unique gene names as row names
rownames(cluster_counts_raw) <- cluster_counts_raw[, 1]

# Remove the first column since it's now the row names
cluster_counts <- cluster_counts_raw[, -1]

# Sanity check
dim(cluster_counts)
head(cluster_counts[, 1:5])


# Read the metadata CSV
metadata <- read.csv("pseudobulk_metadata_general_code_age_layer _sex.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Check the column names and structure
str(metadata)

# Extract the age_layer column (column D)
age_layer <- metadata[[4]]  # or metadata$age_layer
metadata$sex <- factor(metadata$sex)
sex <- metadata[[5]] 


# Preview it
age_layer <- metadata[[4]]; head(age_layer)
sex <- metadata[[5]]; head(sex) 


dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = cluster_counts,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ sex + age_layer
)

# Run DESeq on your dds object
de <- DESeq(dds)

class(de)
# Should return "DESeqDataSet"



L1 old vs young with sex

contrast <- c("age_layer", "old_L1", "young_L1")

# Raw log2 fold change results (no shrinkage)
resLFC <- results(de, contrast = contrast)

 
  # resLFCS <- lfcShrink(de, coef=coef, type="apeglm")
  resLFCS <- lfcShrink(de, contrast=contrast, type="ashr")
  
  # Inspect top genes
head(resLFCS[order(resLFCS$padj), ])

 
  res_df <- as.data.frame(resLFCS)
res_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_df)
# Reorder so gene_id is the first column (optional)
res_df <- res_df[, c("gene_id", setdiff(names(res_df), "gene_id"))]

  
  # Write to file
write.csv(res_df, file = "DESeq2_shrink_old_L1_vs_young_L1_cov_sex.csv", row.names = FALSE)
